newsitem.title: CROATIA: Austrian Creditanstalt to open Croatia brokerage.
newsitem.headline: Austrian Creditanstalt to open Croatia brokerage.

text.p: The investment branch of the Austrian bank Creditanstalt has received permission from the Croatian securities commission to open a brokerage in Croatia, the bank said on Tuesday.

"Today we got a permission from the Croatian Securities Comission to start operating as a brokerage house," said Boris Galic, the spokesman for CAIB d.d., the Croatian subsidiary of the Creditanstalt Investment Bank AG.
"We are planning to become fully operational within one month," Galic said on the telephone.

Founded in 1996, CAIB has so far been engaged in financial consultancy and the licence for dealing in securities will enable the bank to offer the fledgling local financial market a full range of investment banking services, Galic said.

CAIB is to become the third member of the Croatian Stock Exchange controlled by foreign interests, including another Austrian bank, Raiffeisen Investment. -- Davor Huic, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
